purpose: Windows / macOS / Linux application icon candidates

candidates.label: A 圆润终端
candidates.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Asset: one production-quality desktop application icon candidate for TinyShell. Input image is a BRAND REFERENCE for the existing black-and-white terminal-window >_ symbol, not a screenshot to reproduce. Keep this identity: a pure black rounded-square application tile, a white terminal-window outline centered inside it, and ONLY a large white chevron plus underscore >_ inside the window. No words, letters, numbers, SSH badge, titlebar dots, code lines, servers, connections, secondary icons, gradients, glow, shadows, bevels, texture, 3D, or watermark. Flat, crisp, clean raster with vector-like edges. One single icon, not a comparison grid or mockup. Output a square 1024x1024 PNG. The black tile should almost fill the canvas with about 2% transparent outside padding; pixels outside the tile must be genuinely transparent. The terminal window and prompt must remain entirely above 81% of canvas height, leaving the bottom part of the tile solid black without a wordmark. Make all strokes bold enough to read at 16/32/48px; balanced negative space; strictly neutral black/white/grayscale antialiasing only.
Variant A, ROUNDED TERMINAL: soft squircle tile corners, a wide horizontal white terminal window with aspect ratio about 1.5:1, strongly rounded frame corners and rounded line caps. The white window spans roughly 76% canvas width and 50% canvas height, centered at 49% height. The prompt is chunky with smooth rounded ends and a generous horizontal underscore. Approachable and optically balanced; simplest classic terminal icon.
